mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT keep recovering from their recent lows, weekday trips will spill into shopping and dining trips and lift RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks. The signal is a lagged mobility rebound: higher commuting activity precedes higher retail visitation.
